title: SoR style: Typst style from the SoR design system; build the Wisdom paper
description: Implement the approved print mockups (design repo: design-34t.22, projects/sor-design-system/examples/print/) as typst/lib/styles/sor.typ, values from design/projects/sor-design-system/system/tokens.css; start from essay.typ for layout. Build 2rbook/wisdom/essay.md with current text and placeholder figures: cover, title page ('Seeds of Renaissance · No. 6', 'Wisdom · Part 1'), contents, summary boxes, chapter epigraphs per 2rbook/wisdom/publishing-annotations.md. Commit the PDF to output/ and copy it to design examples/print/ as the exemplar. Fonts: Polyamine and Restora need embedding licences (design-34t.2); use open stand-ins until then and say which. Blocked on design-34t.22 (mockups approved). Serves 2rbook rbook-8k3.4. Migrated from GitHub #6.
notes:
2026-10-07: font licences are not a concern (Rufus: have or will buy). Use Polyamine and Restora directly; no stand-ins needed.
2026-10-07: cover is not built here; it comes as a finished image from 2rbook rbook-8k3.29 and is placed as page 1. Page sequence: design print.md 'Anatomy of a paper' (design-34t.22).

title: Delete the superseded v3 engine
description: typst/main.typ, typst/report.typ, typst/theme.typ (built by ./build.sh v3 into output/what-is-2r-typst.pdf) are superseded. Delete once the SoR style is approved. From GitHub #5.

title: Recover Google Docs conventions: bold-line section labels and paradigm triads
description: Two conventions render as plain bold paragraphs in output/what-is-2r.pdf: (1) bold-line labels, some sub-headings, some run-in heads; (2) Modern/Postmodern/Metamodern arrow triads that should set as small tables. Regex misfires (speaker labels, Claim standfirsts), so: scripts/labels.py --list proposes a classification, a human confirms once, answers go in a sidecar (source/what-is-2r.labels.txt) the build verifies. Triads: ^(Modern|Postmodern|Metamodern) →  runs of 2+ become a table; separate smaller change. Full detail: https://github.com/life-itself/pdf-report-publishing/issues/2

title: Read essays from 2rbook instead of a local copy
description: source/ holds its own copy of the 2R essay. The pipeline should take its input from 2rbook (e.g. ../2rbook/what-is-2r/essay.md) so the text has one master. Noted 2026-10-07.

title: Exercise tables in a real document
description: Tables are in the Review spec and implementation but no real document has used them. From GitHub #5 inbox unless noted.

title: Wire bibliography and citations into the styles
description: Typst #bibliography()/#cite() confirmed working in a throwaway doc but not wired into any style. From GitHub #5 inbox unless noted.

title: Exercise a Google Docs to Markdown step
description: No GDocs→Markdown conversion has been run; the sample source was already Markdown. That step is the other half of the real pipeline and lossy for tables, footnotes and comments. From GitHub #5 inbox unless noted.

title: Generalise clean.py beyond the 2R export
description: clean.py handles this one export's quirks, incl. N. / N.M heading-level reconstruction. A real pipeline needs a general Google Docs export cleaner. From GitHub #5 inbox unless noted.

title: Print-on-demand: trim size, bleed, binding gutter
description: Styles are specified for A4 screen and office print only. Address if papers go to print-on-demand. From GitHub #5.
